statement: Every priority control-plane partition is planned from one immutable EffectivePlacement built from the canonical replica inventory and target topology. One serial goal-state owner emits at most one new move per partition tick, or none while an existing transition needs progress, using the precedence failed-replica REMOVE, true-deficit ADD, spread-restoring ADD, monotonic-safe surplus REMOVE, then count-neutral REPLACE. Existing classifiers and admission valves consume that decision until the fixed live gate passes; superseded priority-only parallel candidate and classifier branches are then deleted.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Port cure typing, topology admission, pressure and create budgets, leader-source preference, ledger holds, and remove safety onto the single selected decision; do not weaken or delete them before the Quest's live confirmation gate passes.

Before any live run, prove the owner on failed, deficit, concentrated, surplus, in-flight, unavailable-inventory, and the 2026-07-19 MovieLens post-load REMOVE residual shapes; retain red-on-revert evidence.

The terminal live gate is 5-of-5 formation-probe repetitions green followed by 3-of-3 full-demo repetitions green on unchanged scenarios; thermally invalidated failures are non-measuring, and budgets, deadlines, workload, joins, preload size, ratings split policy, and report semantics are unchanged.
The cutover applies only to priority control-plane partitions; preserve existing non-priority partition, message-group, and runtime-service planning behavior.
